verdict.rationale: Jira explicitly markets agile sprint templates and backlog/board workflows (jira-docs-5), and community feedback confirms backlog/sprint-based workflows are used in practice (jira-comm-11). However, extensive community complaints about UI sluggishness, admin overhead, data loss, and complexity around closing sprints/epics (jira-comm-12, jira-comm-13, jira-comm-17, jira-comm-19) suggest the experience is functional but far from smooth.
